subject: Discovery recap — propose 30m intro (3 windows) and SME owners
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@acmeai.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv@acmeai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap — propose 30m intro (3 windows) and SME owners

Hi Priya / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to learn more about AcmeAI's retrieval pipeline and the latency targets that matter for your client-facing features. Quick recap:

- Primary goals: reduce 95th percentile gen latency under 300ms for core queries, add embedding-based rerank for relevance, and keep inference spend predictable as traffic scales.
- Risk areas you flagged: SOC2 evidence for access logs, and a spike-handling plan during peak launches.
- Next proposed step: a 30-minute product intro + technical Q&A where we can bring our runtime lead and someone from Ops to walk through autoscaling and routing fallbacks.

Could you pick one of these windows? I’ll lock the invite and include our SME(s):
1) Tue Oct 5 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed Oct 6 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu Oct 7 — 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of these work, tell me two 30-minute windows that do and I’ll re-propose. I attached a short post-call deck and a rough mutual action plan so we can align owners.

Prep notes for the meeting: please have an infra/ops lead on the call if possible (we'll do the same). Expected outputs: working success criteria for the pilot and a rough rollout timeline.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: redwood-postcall-deck.pdf (3 slides), acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (worksheet)

From: Priya Rao <priya@acmeai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv@acmeai.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — propose 30m intro (3 windows) and SME owners

Thanks, Soojin — helpful recap.

We can do option 2 (Wed Oct 6 at 14:00 PT). I'll also bring our Platform PM, Anya Gupta (anya@acmeai.com), who will want to confirm rollout timelines and compliance checkpoints. Rajiv will join as well.

Two quick asks before the intro:
- Could your Ops person outline how fallback routing to cheaper model variants would behave during an outage?
- Can you send the SOC2 evidence checklist mentioned on the call (or point to a location where we can pull the artifacts)?

If you can confirm Wed 14:00 PT, I'll accept the invite and add Anya to the calendar.

Best,
Priya
Head of Partnerships | AcmeAI
priya@acmeai.com

Priya — great, Wed Oct 6 at 14:00 PT is locked on our side.

Agenda (30 mins):
1) 5m — Introductions & success criteria confirmation
2) 10m — Product walkthrough: routing, KV/prefix cache, and quantization options
3) 10m — Ops deep-dive: autoscaling and outage fallbacks (we'll show routing rules + fallback to cheaper variants)
4) 5m — Next steps & owners (pilot scope and artifacts required for SOC2).

I'll include our runtime lead (Marcus Lin) and our CS lead (Marissa Cole). I've attached the deck and mutual action plan again and a short 1-pager on our fallback model routing. For SOC2 artifacts, Priyom will share a secure link to the checklist before the meeting.

I'll send the calendar invite now (you should see it from Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>).

Cheers,
Soojin
